circuito-chico.name: Circuito Chico and Llao Llao Viewpoints
circuito-chico.description: About 60 km along the western shore of Nahuel Huapi: coihue forest, Bahía López, and the classic Llao Llao viewpoint. Ideal for a first day, by private car or with a guide.
highlights: Stops at Punto Panorámico and Colonia Suiza
Views of Lake Moreno and Cerro López
Half day; pairs well with a free afternoon downtown

isla-victoria-arrayanes.name: Victoria Island and Arrayán Forest Navigation
isla-victoria-arrayanes.description: Departure from Puerto Pañuelo to Nahuel Huapi National Park. Walk among centuries-old arrayán trees on the Quetrihué peninsula (access depends on lake level).
highlights: Unique arrayán forest on the lakeshore
Victoria Island with short trails among cypresses
Operates in high season; advance booking recommended

refugio-frey.name: Trek to Refugio Frey
refugio-frey.description: Ascent on Cerro Catedral to the refuge on the shores of Laguna Toncek, with direct views of the massif's spires. One of Bariloche's most popular treks.
highlights: About 10 km one way (4–5 h) from the Catedral base
Moderate difficulty; bring warm layers even in summer
Can be done independently or with a mountain guide

huechulafquen-lanin.name: Huechulafquen Lake, Paimún and Lanín Volcano
huechulafquen-lanin.description: Departure at 9:00 a.m. from San Martín de los Andes. You visit Junín de los Andes and the Laura Vicuña church, the mouth of the Chimehuín River, and Lake Huechulafquen with Lanín Volcano in the background throughout. Along the lakeshore you enter the Andean-Patagonian forest, lunch at a countryside restaurant run by the Mapuche community, and continue on Route 61 to Lake Paimún, the lakeside chapel, and a forest of thousand-year-old araucarias at the foot of Lanín. Return at 6:00 p.m.
highlights: Full day · departure 9:00 a.m. and return 6:00 p.m.
Junín de los Andes, Chimehuín River and Lake Huechulafquen
Lunch at a local Mapuche restaurant
Lake Paimún, chapel and thousand-year-old araucarias
Lanín National Park entrance fee not included

lacar-quila-quina.name: Lácar Lake Navigation to Quila Quina
lacar-quila-quina.description: Half-day excursion from San Martín along Lake Lácar, with views of Volcán Colorado and Cerro Sabana. You venture into lands of the Curruhuinca Mapuche Community and return to the lake with a different panorama toward Villa Quila Quina: a valley between water and mountains, with community settlements, summer homes, a café, a boat dock, and beaches to have lunch, share mate, or enjoy the backdrop of Cerro Abanico.
highlights: Half day from San Martín de los Andes
Curruhuinca Mapuche Community and Villa Quila Quina
Views of Volcán Colorado and Cerro Sabana
Dock, beaches and café facing Cerro Abanico
Lanín National Park entrance fee not included

laguna-de-los-tres.name: Laguna de los Tres
laguna-de-los-tres.description: The town's signature trek: ascent to the viewpoint facing Fitz Roy. The final stretch is steep; the reward is the view of the glacier and the spires.
highlights: Full day (8–10 h round trip from town)
Start early; bring food, water and warm layers
If winds are strong at the lagoon, rescheduling is advisable

condores-aguilas.name: Cóndores and Águilas Viewpoints
condores-aguilas.description: Short trails above town with views of Fitz Roy, Cerro Torre, and the Río de las Vueltas valley. Condors are often seen at sunset.
highlights: Under 2 h round trip; low difficulty
Perfect on arrival day for acclimatization
Very photogenic sunsets at Águilas

lago-del-desierto.name: Lago del Desierto and Huemul Glacier
lago-del-desierto.description: Excursion to the northern end of the valley, near the Chilean border. Turquoise lake, hanging glacier, and humid forest; requires more time than the town's classic trails.
highlights: Half or full day depending on whether you cross by boat
Landscape distinct from the classic Fitz Roy circuit
Check road conditions according to the season

los-alerces.name: Los Alerces National Park
los-alerces.description: UNESCO World Heritage site: emerald-green lakes and alerce trees over 2,600 years old in the temperate rainforest. Access via Villa Futalaufquen or Lago Verde.
highlights: Lake Menéndez and Glaciar Torrecillas viewpoint
Guided half-day or full-day hikes
Book well in advance in season (limited capacity)

lago-futalaufquen.name: Futalaufquen Lake Navigation
lago-futalaufquen.description: Tour along the lake's main arm within the park, with guides explaining glacial formation and forest flora.
highlights: Turquoise water between mountains
Suitable for those who prefer minimal physical effort
Subject to wind; spectacular on calm days

trevelin.name: Valle 16 de Octubre and Trevelin
trevelin.description: Route through the Welsh colony of Trevelin: windmills, homemade tea, waterfalls, and Patagonian steppe. Often combined with a day at Los Alerces.
highlights: Living Welsh culture (bakeries, museums)
Nant y Fall waterfall and mountain viewpoints
Done by car with stops; day tours also available

kayak.name: Kayaking in Villa La Angostura
kayak.description: Paddle a kayak through corners of Nahuel Huapi, Correntoso, Espejo, and other lakes on the Seven Lakes circuit. Guided departures with local experts who take you to places reachable only with proper equipment and local knowledge. An active way to disconnect and fully immerse yourself in the landscape.
highlights: Nahuel Huapi, Correntoso, Espejo lakes and more
Guided departures with local professionals
Proper equipment for each lake section
Ideal for those seeking adventure at their own pace

alquiler-bicicletas.name: Bicycle Rental
alquiler-bicicletas.description: Mountain bikes to explore the main circuits and natural landscapes of Villa La Angostura. Hourly or daily options with safety accessories. An active, sustainable way to discover Patagonia at your own pace.
highlights: Mountain bikes for local circuits and trails
Hourly or daily rental
Helmet and safety accessories included
Ideal to combine with beaches and viewpoints

bosque-arrayanes.name: Navigation to the Arrayán Forest
bosque-arrayanes.description: Boat ride across the lake to the Arrayán Forest, unique in the world. Trails among centuries-old arrayán trees, copper-toned landscape over the water, afternoon tea included, and return to the dock.
highlights: Lake navigation with a local guide
Arrayán forest on the Quetrihué peninsula
Trails and boardwalks among ancient trees
Afternoon tea included · return to the dock

peninsula-valdes.name: Península Valdés
peninsula-valdes.description: UNESCO reserve: elephant seals at Punta Delgada, Magellanic penguins at Punta Tombo (seasonal), and whales in the gulf from the cliff.
highlights: Full day by vehicle with interpretive stops
Orcas at Caleta Valdés (Feb–Apr, tide dependent)
Bring binoculars and warm clothing — windy year-round

ballenas-embarcacion.name: Whale Watching by Boat
ballenas-embarcacion.description: Departures from Puerto Pirámides (Península Valdés) to see southern right whales just meters from the boat. Main season: September to December.
highlights: Strict regulations to avoid disturbing the animals
Book weeks in advance during high season
Departures rescheduled if seas are rough

punta-loma.name: Punta Loma and Coastal Reserves
punta-loma.description: South American fur seals at Punta Loma reserve, 17 km from Madryn. An ideal complement if you don't have a full day for the peninsula.
highlights: Half day from downtown Madryn
Viewpoint over Golfo Nuevo
Pairs well with a city tour or free afternoon

perito-moreno.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
perito-moreno.description: Walkways facing an ice wall nearly 80 m high above Brazo Rico. Calving events and blue hues that shift with the daylight.
highlights: Year-round access to Los Glaciares National Park
Free time at viewpoints + optional south-face navigation
Arrive early in January and February

todo-glaciares.name: Todo Glaciares Navigation
todo-glaciares.description: Full day on the northern arm of Lake Argentino: Upsala, Spegazzini, and giant icebergs. One of the most comprehensive navigations in the south.
highlights: Boat to the front of rarely visited glaciers
Includes transfer from Calafate and deck time
Book in advance during the austral summer

laguna-nimez.name: Laguna Nimez Reserve
laguna-nimez.description: Interpretive trail beside Lake Argentino, minutes from downtown. Flamingos, black-necked swans, and migratory birds depending on the season.
highlights: 1–2 h easy walk; great on arrival or farewell day
Sunset over Lake Argentino
Separate entrance from the glacier park

bosque-sumergido.name: Navigation to the Submerged Forest
bosque-sumergido.description: A unique experience to explore an ancient forest submerged beneath the waters of Lake Traful, with natural scenery and crystal-clear water. Ideal for those seeking adventure, nature, and views found nowhere else in Patagonia.
highlights: Submerged forest visible from the boat or by snorkeling
Crystal-clear water on calm days
Local guides explain the valley's geology
Subject to weather and season

cabalgata.name: Horseback Riding in Traful
cabalgata.description: Ride mountain trails and Patagonian forests on horseback, with unique landscapes, pure air, and unforgettable views of Villa Traful and Lake Traful.
highlights: Guided departures on mountain trails
Patagonian forest and lake viewpoints
Suitable for different experience levels
Check schedules and availability by season

tierra-del-fuego.name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
tierra-del-fuego.description: Fuegian forest, peat bogs, and Beagle Channel coastline. Classics: Coastal Trail, Lapataia (end of Route 3), and the End of the World train (optional).
highlights: Half day or full day depending on trails chosen
Views of Chilean mountains from the coast
Strong winds common — waterproof layer essential

canal-beagle.name: Beagle Channel Navigation
canal-beagle.description: Tour along the channel separating Argentina and Chile: Les Éclaireurs Lighthouse, Bird Island, and sea lions on Sea Lion Island.
highlights: 4–6 h departures from Ushuaia port
Option to visit Estancia Harberton (depending on tour)
Cold on deck even in summer

laguna-esmeralda.name: Laguna Esmeralda Trek
laguna-esmeralda.description: Lenga forest and peat bogs to an emerald-colored glacial lagoon, with views over Valle de Tierra Mayor. One of the city's most popular treks.
highlights: About 4–5 h round trip; muddy final sections
Waterproof boots almost essential
In winter may require snowshoes or crampons
